claims.value: 32 Orbitrap Velos Pro RAW files: CHO E317A cells treated with TPA or ethanol across four dated experiments and four repeated injections each.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol explicitly states three to four repeated runs per sample; filenames encode date, TPA/EtOH, and run 1-4.

limitations: The deposit identifies the engineered cells only as CHO, so the required cell-line accession/name fields are explicitly not available.
Dated experiments are biological replicate groups; numbered runs are technical replicates.
